The collection driver will use the reference printed on your return label. Scans it at the door. Links it to the parcel.
The parser reads the first line before choosing a delimiter. Counts the separators. Picks the most frequent one.
The new reminder watches the due date on each open task. Notices an approaching deadline. Nudges the owner.
Our receptionist prepares the visitor badges before the first appointment. Checks the names. Lays them out by arrival time.
The managed plan assigns a technician to each heating inspection. Keeps the service record. Arranges the next visit.
The volunteer steward opens the reading room at nine on Saturdays. Switches on the lamps. Welcomes the first visitors.
The feeder releases a measured portion when the clock reaches the time I set. Turns its little wheel. Drops the biscuits.
The observer follows one pupil through the group exercise. Notes each request for help. Records the response.
A good estimator visits the site before putting a number beside the job. Measures the access. Questions the assumptions.
The ferry office handles every application for a resident's pass. Takes the photograph. Stamps the card.
The assessment team reviews the photographs attached to your claim. Looks for the broken fitting. Matches it to the parts diagram.
The cleanup job visits temporary folders older than a day. Checks for an active lock. Removes the abandoned files.
The address picker now consults your recent deliveries before showing suggestions. Finds the familiar streets. Brings them forward.
The night porter checks the upstairs windows after the last class leaves. Tries the catches. Closes the blinds.
The full bookkeeping service collects invoices from a shared email address. Sorts them by supplier. Adds them to the ledger.
Our new crossing volunteer helps families at the junction beside the nursery. Watches the traffic. Signals when to cross.
The timer on this heater remembers the weekday schedule after a power cut. Keeps the morning start. Restores the evening setting.
The curator groups the pottery by the layer in which it was found. Compares the rims. Estimates the dates.
A workshop supervisor sees a problem before it reaches the customer. Spots the uneven seam. Stops the batch.
The repair shop at the corner takes in old radios every Thursday. Tests the valves. Rewinds the coils.
The billing specialist handles accounts with duplicate payments. Checks the bank reference. Returns the extra amount.
The preview service opens the document in a separate process. Renders the first page. Sends back a small image.
The updated assistant prepares a packing slip from the items marked ready. Pulls in their weights. Adds the destination.
The duty coordinator calls the substitute when a tutor reports an absence. Confirms the room. Passes on the lesson notes.
The seed librarian checks each donated envelope before putting it in the drawer. Reads the date. Copies the variety.
An attentive account manager stays involved after the order is signed. Follows the delivery. Asks about the installation.
